axis_definition: rotation columns are x=gripper closing axis across the book thickness, y=spine axis towards the top of the book, z=approach axis into the shelf
position_definition: spine_contact_center_m lies on the fitted spine plane midway between the two measured thickness boundaries; grasp_position_m is that point moved grasp_insertion_mm along +z and pregrasp_position_m is it moved grasp_approach_mm along -z
